en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Tuesday morning
en.dek: The warning was issued at 6.45am as the city heads for a mainly sunny and very hot day, with urban highs of about 33 degrees and isolated afternoon showers.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 6.45am on Tuesday, saying very hot weather was expected across the territory. At 8am the Observatory recorded 28 degrees and 81 per cent relative humidity, with light winds.

The official forecast called for a mainly fine day. Daytime heat is expected to push urban temperatures to about 33 degrees, and a degree or two higher in parts of the New Territories, with isolated showers in some areas later in the afternoon.

The Observatory advised the public to beware of heat stroke and to drink more water. It said older people, pregnant women, infants and children, and people with chronic illnesses such as heart disease or high blood pressure are more vulnerable, and that those working or exercising outdoors should avoid over-exertion and rest in the shade if they feel unwell.

Looking ahead, the Observatory said there would be sunny periods and a few showers over the next two to three days. A broad area of low pressure is expected to develop over the central South China Sea later in the week, and together with the northeast monsoon it may bring stronger winds and more showers around the weekend.

zh.headline: 天文台今早發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午6晈45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，下午局部地區有驟雨。
body: 香港天文台今日上午6晈45分發出酷熱天氣警告，表示本港天氣酷熱。上午8晈天文台錄得氣溫28度，相對濕81%，吹微風。
天文台預測今日大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高一兩度，下午局部地區有驟雨。
天文台提醒市民慎防中暑，多補充水分。長者、孕婦、嬰幼兒，以及患有心臟病或高血壓等長期病患的人士較易中暑；在戶外工作或活動的人士應避免過度勞累，不適應盡快到陰涼處休息。
展望未來兩三日部分時間有陽光，亦有一兩陣驟雨。天文台表示，一個廣闊低壓區本周後期將在南海中部逐漸發展，與東北季候風共同影響下，周末期間廣東沿岸風勢較大，有幾陣驟雨。
